request.text:
Employee ticket:
help pls, urgent

Knowledge base:
[1] Move MFA to a new phone · Before you start
## Before you start
You need your laptop signed in, or a one-time code from the help desk.

[2] Request sudo on an engineering workstation · Policy
## Policy
Engineers get time-limited sudo through the access portal with team lead approval. The help desk cannot grant sudo directly.

[3] VPN client troubleshooting policy (2024) · Policy
## Policy
If the VPN keeps dropping and a profile reset does not help, uninstall the VPN client and reinstall it from the software portal. Employees may reinstall the client themselves.

reply.value:
I am sorry to hear you are having trouble, but I need more information to assist you. Please specify which issue you are experiencing:

1. If you need to move MFA to a new phone, you need your laptop signed in, or a one-time code from the help desk.
2. If you need sudo on an engineering workstation, Engineers get time-limited sudo through the access portal with team lead approval. The help desk cannot grant sudo directly.
3. If you are having VPN issues, if the VPN keeps dropping and a profile reset does not help, uninstall the VPN client and reinstall it from the software portal
